sides.description: at least two sides, one per evidence item

statement.description: short English paraphrase of what this evidence says

explanation.description: why these values are different measures, not a conflict

basis.description: measurement basis for areas/volumes, else null

evidenceIds.description: every catalog ID that supports this fact

key.description: snake_case English fact name, e.g. living_area

value.description: number copied exactly from the evidence, or English text
